title: Native proper tensor-comparison data
statement: Given the native coefficient-operation datum [def-sf-native-proper-coefficient-operations] and the normalized tensor models of [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization], define its tensor/unit comparison datum as follows. The termwise balanced pullback comparison of the total tensor complexes of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model] is fixed on homogeneous generators by $1\otimes(x\otimes y)\mapsto(1\otimes x)\otimes(1\otimes y)$. Require preservation of K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex] and require its derived comparison to commute with the actual pullback computation counits and the specified K-flat tensor model isomorphisms. The termwise comparison of the coefficient-unit complexes of [def-zl-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal-data] is fixed on unit sections by the structural coefficient map, and its derived unit comparison commutes with the actual pullback counit and the coefficient-unit models. This defines a type of normalized comparison data, not an existence assertion.
